content_zh:
一声痛苦的嘶鸣。
女子高亢的尖叫声，在山崖下传出好远好远……
花月奴浑身是汗，身上的衣衫早已经被尽数打湿，她脸上神情痛苦难捺，不时发出一阵阵无法忍耐的痛苦呻~吟声。
要生了。
既然苏景接到的任务是保证江枫一家四口的安全，而时限只有七天，也就是说无论如何，就算花月奴没有被十二星相给惊动了胎气，七天之内，也必定是要生孩子的。
而现在，已经是第七天了。
不过之前在那种环境下，没有热水，周边凶险的地方都能平安的把两个孩子给生下来，可见花月奴定然是个能生养的，体质相当好……而在这里，有江枫悉心照顾着，有燕南天用嫁衣神功烧了一大锅的开水，莫说两个孩子，就是再生俩也绰绰有余！
“呜~~~！！！”
跟她同时痛叫的，其实还有苏景！
山崖下地方狭窄，因此兄弟俩只能各占一边地方，江枫伺侯着花月奴生产，燕南天则小心的维持着苏景的生命，准备将嫁衣神功的功力传授给他！
因此，虽然因为身体无比虚弱的缘故，只能发出很轻微的呻~吟声，但苏景觉得，他和花月奴一东一西，花月奴固然是疼的撕心裂肺，但自己恐怕也不遑多让吧？
旁的不说，苏景体内的筋脉早在七天前被邀月以明玉真气生生撕开，更在里面留下了一道无比阴寒的真气。
之前又被邀月打伤，阴寒之气更盛！
但现在，燕南天却又将嫁衣神功的真气输送到了他的体内。
冰火相激！
苏景的身体便成了战场……
把本来冰冷的水烧滚会是个什么体验？
苏景这回总算是知道了，最起码也是跟分娩不相上下的痛苦啊！
仅剩一只的手臂，其内筋络疯狂扭曲，脸上早已经大汗淋漓，汗水才刚刚生出，便已经凝结成冰。
不一会儿，苏景已经成了冰人一样。

纵然苏景另外一个身份楚南曾经经受过太多太多磨难，但那毕竟都是心灵上的，身体上的痛楚……这般的痛楚，却是从未曾经历过，若非他此时仍然处在昏迷不醒的奇妙状态，恐怕叫的比花月奴更大声。
而效果自然也是非凡的。
汹涌澎湃的真气，如汪洋大海，倾巢而入，尽数灌输到了自己的体内！
苏景能够清楚的感觉到自己体内，迅速充盈了无比强大的真气，甚至于……连邀月之前输送给自己的明玉真气都远远无法比拟。
他不知道这股真气量到底有多少，但却可以感觉到，这股真气如浩瀚大海，浩荡无尽。
兼之这真气更是汹涌暴虐如火山喷发，威力之强，较之寻常真气，胜了何止一筹！
难怪燕南天早知嫁衣神功有诸多缺陷，却还要强行修炼……只因为恐怕没有任何一个武者，可以拒绝这强大真气的诱~惑吧？
但你给我……
苏景苦笑，心道这般暴虐如火的真气，莫说我了，便连你都无法驾驭，你强行给我塞了这么强大的真气，到时候回到现世，以我楚南的身份，恐怕立即就会成为所有人的眼中钉，肉中刺！
你不管我，我自己回到现世，自然就没事了！
可你这一救，却生生给我救出了个大危机来！
回到现世，你让我怎么解释我突然就拥有了这么强大的力量？
想着……
苏景就觉得，这痛苦受的好没来由！
“哇~~~哇~~~”
一声尖亮的婴儿啼哭声响起，给这山谷内增添了些许的生机！
“是儿子……是儿子……”
江枫抱着那浑身沾满血迹的儿子，脸上露出了激动的神色。
而花月奴却仍然满脸痛楚，叫道：“还……还有一个……还有一个……”
“是双胞胎？！”

江枫瞬间大喜，然后大是惊慌，他本来就不专业，只是之前抓住了一个稳婆打听了些关键的问题，现在直接让他结生两个……怀里还一个没人帮忙抱呢。
回头看了一眼，自己大哥的传功大业仍然兢兢业业，还没完成。
一咬牙，一手抱着孩儿，再度开始了自己的接生大业！
而苏景此时身上出的汗，甚至于比生孩子的花月奴还要多，他满脸皆是难以忍耐的痛苦神色，而此时，体外的冰霜已经逐渐化去，取而代之的，是火红的肌肤……
之前如果说是冷热交替，那么现在，便是灼热的感觉蔓延全身，如果不是背后那一只手始终不曾脱离，苏景甚至于会怀疑自己是不是已经在燃烧了。

content_en:
A scream of pain.
The woman's high-pitched scream could be heard far, far away under the cliff...
Hua Yuenu was covered in sweat, and all her clothes had been soaked. She had a painful expression on her face, and from time to time she let out bursts of unbearable painful moans.
It's time to give birth.
Since the task Su Jing received was to ensure the safety of Jiang Feng's family of four, and the time limit was only seven days, that meant that no matter what, even if Huayue Nu was not alarmed by the twelve astrology, she would definitely give birth within seven days.
And now, it's the seventh day.
But before, in that environment, there was no hot water, and the surrounding dangerous places were able to give birth to two children safely. It can be seen that Huayue Nu must be fertile and has a very good constitution... But here, with Jiang Feng taking good care of her, and Yan Nantian using the magic power of wedding clothes to boil a large pot of boiling water, not to mention two children, even two more are more than enough!
"Woo~~~!!!"
The one who screamed in pain at the same time as her was actually Su Jing!
The place under the cliff is narrow, so the two brothers can only occupy one side of the place. Jiang Feng waits for Huayuenu to give birth, while Yan Nantian carefully maintains Su Jing's life and prepares to teach him the power of the wedding dress magic!
Therefore, although his body was extremely weak and he could only make a slight moan, Su Jing felt that he and Hua Yuenu were going one and the other. Although Hua Yuenu was in pain, he probably couldn't give in more, right?
Apart from other things, the tendons and veins in Su Jing's body were torn apart by Yao Yue seven days ago with Mingyu's true energy, leaving an extremely cold true energy inside.
I was injured by Yaoyue again before, and my cold and cold energy became even stronger!
But now, Yan Nantian has transferred the true energy of the Wedding Clothes Magic Art into his body.
Fire and ice clash!
Su Jing's body became a battlefield...
What would it be like to boil cold water?
Su Jing finally knew this time, at least it was as painful as childbirth!
There was only one arm left, and the muscles in it were twisted crazily. His face was already dripping with sweat, and the sweat had just condensed into ice.
After a while, Su Jing turned into an ice man.
Even though Su Jing's other identity, Chu Nan, had experienced too many hardships, they were all mental and physical pain after all... Such pain had never been experienced before. If he hadn't been in a strange state of unconsciousness at this time, he would have screamed louder than Huayue Nu.
And the effect is naturally extraordinary.
The surging true energy, like a vast ocean, poured in and poured it all into his body!
Su Jing could clearly feel that his body was quickly filled with extremely powerful Qi, to the point that... even the Mingyu Qi that Yao Yue had sent to him before was far incomparable.
He didn't know how much this true energy was, but he could feel that this true energy was like a vast ocean, endless.
At the same time, this true energy is even more violent and violent, like a volcanic eruption. It is so powerful that it is much more powerful than ordinary true energy!
No wonder Yan Nantian knew long ago that the Wedding Clothes Divine Art had many flaws, yet he still forced himself to practice it... just because no warrior could resist the temptation of this powerful true energy, right?
But you give me...
Su Jing smiled bitterly, thinking that even you, not to mention me, can't control such tyrannical Qi. You forcefully stuffed me with such powerful Qi. When I return to this world, as Chu Nan, I will probably become a thorn in everyone's side and a thorn in the flesh!
If you don't care about me, I'll be fine if I return to this world on my own!
But with this rescue, you saved me from a big crisis!
Back in this world, how do you want me to explain that I suddenly have such a powerful power?
Thinking about...
Su Jing felt that there was no reason for the pain!
"Wow~~~Wow~~~"
A shrill baby cry sounded, giving the valleyIt adds a little life inside!
"It's a son... it's a son..."
Jiang Feng held his son, who was covered in blood, with an excited look on his face.
But Hua Yuenu's face was still full of pain, and she shouted: "There's... there's one more... there's one more..."
"Twins?!"
Jiang Feng was overjoyed for a moment, and then panicked. He was not a professional to begin with, but he just caught a stable woman to ask some key questions, and now he just let him give birth to two children... and there was still one in his arms with no one to help him.
Looking back, I saw that my elder brother was still working diligently on his great work and had not yet completed it.
He gritted his teeth, held the baby in one hand, and started his career of delivering babies again!
Su Jing was sweating more than Huayue Nu when she gave birth. His face was filled with unbearable pain. At this time, the frost outside his body had gradually melted away, replaced by fiery red skin...
If it was the alternation of hot and cold before, now, the burning feeling spreads throughout the body. If it weren't for the hand behind his back that never left his body, Su Jing would even doubt whether he was burning.
